# New renderings chosen in odyssey-111 (Odyssey 23.1-96)

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| φίλον τέκος / τέκνον φίλον / τέκνον ἐμόν (23.5, 23.26, 23.70; address of nurse to Penelope) | "dear child" / "dear child" / "my child" | "dear child" / "dear child" / "my child" | "daughter", "girl", "darling"; follows the table's τέκος "child" with φίλος "dear" kept |
| θεῶν αἰειγενετάων (genitive, 23.81; extends the table's θεοῖς αἰειγενέτῃσι) | "the gods who are forever-born" | "the everlasting gods" | "the gods who are forever" (reserved for θεοὶ αἰὲν ἐόντες) |
| ἀναιδής (of the suitors, 23.37, μνηστῆρσιν ἀναιδέσι) | "shameless" | "shameless" | "ruthless", "unfeeling", "impudent" |
| ὑπερώϊα / ὑπερῷα (23.1, 23.85) | "the upper rooms" | "the upper rooms" | "upstairs", "upper chamber" (singular), "attic" |
| ἰφθίμη παράκοιτις (23.92) | "mighty consort" | "mighty wife" | "stately", "noble wife"; ἰφθίμη keeps the table's "mighty" (ἰφθίμη κούρη), παράκοιτις keeps "consort" / "wife" |
| πολύϊδρις / πολυϊδρείη (23.77, 23.82) | "much-knowing" / "great knowing" | "very knowing" / "cunning" | "much-wise", "clever", "wise" |
| μάργος (23.11, μάργην σε θεοὶ θέσαν) | "mad" | "mad" | "frenzied", "foolish", "crazy" |
| σαοφροσύνη (23.13, 23.30) | "sound-mindedness" | "good sense" / "prudence" | "temperance", "moderation", "wisdom" |
| καγχαλόωσα (23.1, 23.59) | "exulting" | "exulting" | "laughing loudly", "gloating", "cackling" |
| λωβεύω (23.15, 23.26) | "mock" | "mock" | "abuse", "insult", "make sport of" |
| Τηλέμαχος δ’ ἐνένιπεν ἔπος τ’ ἔφατ’ ἔκ τ’ ὀνόμαζε (23.96; whole-line speech introduction, rebuke with unstated object, built on the table's ἀμφίπολον δ’ ἐνένιπεν … row) | "and Telemachus rebuked her and spoke a word and called her by name:" | "Telemachus rebuked her, and spoke, calling her by name:" | "scolded", "reproached", "addressed" |
| τὴν δ’ ἠμείβετ’ ἔπειτα φίλη τροφὸς Εὐρύκλεια (23.69; table's ἠμείβετο formula with the nurse's standing name) | "Her then answered the dear nurse Eurycleia:" | "Then her dear nurse Eurycleia answered her:" | "in turn" (reserved for αὖτε) |
| κακὰ χροῒ εἵματα (23.95) | "bad clothes upon his skin" | "shabby clothes on his body" | "rags", "foul garments" |
| οὐκ ἔα εἰπέμεναι (23.77) | "did not allow to tell" | "would not let me tell" | "forbade" |
